day_signal.gray: no planned meal has been logged
day_signal.yellow: day is partially logged or complete adherence is between 50% and 84%
day_signal.green: all planned meals are logged and adherence is at least 85%
day_signal.red: all planned meals are logged and adherence is below 50%

invariants: Diary writes never edit the effective plan.
A manual or extra meal never lowers plan adherence by itself.
Historical diary entries retain a planned snapshot even if the plan later changes.
Phase C.2 ingredients, recipes and 180-day plan remain byte-identical.
